description: This file defines a controller class for handling customer search reports in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for displaying the report interface, saving configuration, fetching report data, and rendering views related to customer search analytics.

classes.name: CustomerSearch
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer search reports in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads necessary language, sets page title, builds breadcrumbs, and renders the customer search report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the customer search report, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer search report page with data fetched via getReport.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report data, primarily for AJAX or partial refresh.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves customer search data based on filters, handles pagination, and renders the report list view.
